summary: Validated all 4 new feature additions (multi-survey CRUD, backend QR PNG, Hapus Data Demo, XLSX export) via pytest (16 new tests) and Playwright end-to-end. All targeted data-testids present and working. Backend 100%, frontend 100% of new flows verified.

ui_bugs.issue: The close icon button has type='submit' which could accidentally submit the editor form on Enter. Should be type='button'.

action_items: (Optional) Change close-editor-button type to 'button' and add a data-testid to the 'Batal' button.
(Carry-over from iter2) Login brute-force lockout still worth re-verifying against the live ingress — not retested this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: Multi-survey CRUD, QR PNG, XLSX export, clear demo endpoints all return proper status codes and content types.
Backend correctly blocks deleting the last remaining survey with HTTP 400 and the required Indonesian message.
QR PNG endpoint returns valid PNG magic bytes and 404 for unknown slugs.
Backend seed re-populates demo data on startup when demo responses are absent — tests restart backend to restore state.
Dashboard survey filter and Responses survey filter correctly appear only when more than one survey exists.
Pydantic SurveyIn requires min_length=3 on text fields; frontend should surface server-side validation errors clearly (not tested if the editor shows field-level errors for too-short input).

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 new + 6/6 regression after backend restart to re-seed demo)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of new feature flows (create/edit/delete survey, QR view+download, CSV+XLSX export, dashboard+responses survey filter, Hapus Data Demo with modal+toast+count update)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted a 'test-pelayanan-admin' survey through UI; posted 1 TEST response to it; triggered demo clear which deleted 80 demo responses (Total Responden 84 -> 4). Restarted backend at end to re-seed demo (84 confirmed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features work end-to-end. Only cosmetic/low-prio notes: close icon button is type=submit, Batal has no testid. Regression test test_admin_me_and_analytics_have_real_data in test_survey_regression.py asserts total>=80, which will fail if run after any Hapus Data Demo test unless backend is restarted first. Backend seed only runs on startup when demo responses collection is empty.
rca of the issue: No new issues. Prior iteration-2 login lockout issue was not re-tested in this iteration.
